commentary.text: 90+10' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+7' The corner kick from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+7' James McAtee (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

90+6' Enzo Fernandez sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
90+6' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is about to take a corner kick.
90+5' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

62' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

59' Nice passing game by Nottingham. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.

54' Anthony Taylor sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
53' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

45+10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Matz Sels leaps out to thwart his attempt.
45+10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
45+9' Jesse Derry looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Calum McFarlane has decided that Liam Delap (Chelsea) is the man to take his place.
45+5' It appears to be a head injury for Zach Abbott so no chances are being taken and he’s replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
45+1' Zach Abbott (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' Jesse Derry (Chelsea) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.

23' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.

11' Post! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
